public_interface: pct_rank(values: list[float], v: float | None, min_n: int = 252) -> float | None — 0-100 分位（严格小于计数/n×100），n<min_n→None
rolling_dd52(closes: list[float]) -> list[float] — 每日 dd52w 序列（单调队列 O(n)），closes<300→[]
dd_rank3y(closes: list[float]) -> dict | None — {'pct','n'}：当前跌深在自身 3 年分布排位（pct 高=极深）；=pctile_dd52w 单一实现
beta_corr60(rows, bench_rows, win=60) -> dict | None — {'beta60','corr60','n','asof'}；bench_rows 接受 kline 行列表或 {date:close} 映射（性能通道）；n<40→None
knifebook_context(dd52w, book) -> dict | None — {'deeper_than','of':18,'nearest':[{case,drawdown_pct,trading_days,fwd_3m_pct}×3]}（档案 i 节退化链唯一实现）
obs_gates(store) -> list[dict] — 8 条观察闸 {id,name,value,threshold,on,warn,pct3y,asof,lag_note,caliber[,nodata,coin,circ_run,spread,inverted]}，display-only 绝不入主闸/blade_index/state
market_pctiles(store) -> dict — 7 键(vix/pcr_equity/pcr_index/move/vvix/fund_BTC/fund_ETH) 各 {value,pct3y,n,asof}，窗 756 观测

build_chain(det, gates, th, st=None, today=None, jev_gate=None) -> list[dict] — 8 环决策链 {id,name,inputs,rule_text,pass(true|false|null),blocking,next_text,j7_map}，第 5 环带 subs 5 子行实数；engine=display 只回第 1 环；唯一 blocking 环

build_depth(board, store, ctx=None) -> dict — 就地写 det['depth']={dd_rank,knifebook,beta60,corr60,cot,earnings,si,auction}（缺键省略），返回 payload.depth_market={global_sync,cot_extremes,stable,tvl,earnings_upcoming,auction_windows}；ctx 可注入 {cot,earnings,si,auction,book}，默认只读 data/state/*.json；幂等
market_gates(store) -> dict — 末尾新挂 g['obs_gates'] / g['pctiles'] / g['flip_back_age_days']（gates_prev 边沿计龄，只读；非 flip_back→None，边沿日=0）；主闸/state/blade_index 公式零改动

detect(inst, th, gates, fund_last) -> dict — 新事实量 z1d/worst_day_252_pct/sigma20_ann_pct/beta/corr60/beta_bench/pctile_dd52w/dd_rank_n/fall_rule/checklist_facts；close_only 走 no_volume 先例（量比/收位/ATR 项 None）；新 cls 路由 sector_etf→thresholds.sector_fall、credit_etf→thresholds.credit_fall（config 缺失用规格默认）
run_engine(store, insts, fund, veto_keys=frozenset()) -> dict — board 行全员带 det['chain']；返回值新增 result['depth_market']；KW_RADAR=1 仍零 state 写入
